rows.corpus_definition: A grain used for making food or drinks.
rows.example_en: Farmers grew fields of barley for the market.

rows.corpus_definition: A poor person who asks others for money in public places.
rows.example_en: The beggar asked for coins on the street corner.

rows.corpus_definition: a person who gives help or money to support others
rows.example_en: An anonymous benefactor donated funds to the local hospital.

rows.corpus_definition: The variety of all living things in a specific area.
rows.example_en: We must protect the biodiversity of our oceans.

rows.corpus_definition: A very large, bright, and strong fire.

rows.corpus_definition: To make a hot drink like tea or coffee.

rows.corpus_definition: A dark mark on your skin after a hit.
rows.example_en: He got a big bruise on his leg.

rows.corpus_definition: A piece of land that sticks out into the sea.
rows.example_en: The ship sailed around the rocky cape.

rows.corpus_definition: A substance in food that gives the body energy.

rows.corpus_definition: The total amount of gases a person puts into the air.
rows.example_en: I want to reduce my carbon footprint by cycling.
